newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 22.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ivorian Commodities Minister Guy-Alain Gauze elected head of the Inter-African Coffee Organisation; calls for solidarity among producers to boost flagging world prices.
- Trading and retail company Peyrissac Cote d'Ivoire says in announcement its turnover rose 22 percent in 1995/96 financial year over 1994/95.
- Nestle Cote d'Ivoire says in announcement its turnover rose 8.7 percent in six month from April to September over same period in 1995, sales up 30 percent
- Frenchman named as manager of Ivory Coast's national soccer squad Robert Nouzaret has yet to sign his contract; talks continue
- Technical problems delayed publication of Friday's edition of this newspaper
